name: manual_02c40b
claim: agent_coordination heartbeat cleanup releases only legacy agent_claim rows; the distributed-queue exclusion gate (task_claims) is cleaned by heartbeat_monitor's cleanup_stale_queue_claims, and its DEAD classification can mislabel an 80h-silent agent as IDLE — verify stale queue claims manually and use the sanctioned fail-as-claimant path (queue fail <id> <claimant> then claim+complete) for dead-claimant closure

decisions.notes: gate4-f07-port-allowlist stayed claimed after cleanup ran; heartbeat_monitor classified its 80h-silent claimant IDLE, so auto-release skipped it; manual fail path closed it cleanly.
